name: Crocodile
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Stealth +2. Passive Perception 10. No listed languages.
appearance: A heavy crocodile with a tapered snout, interlocking teeth, dark olive-brown back scutes, and a long armored tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0, November 2018, p. 122.
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The crocodile can hold its breath for 15 minutes.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one creature. On a hit, deal 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage and grapple the target (escape DC 12). The target is restrained during the grapple, and the crocodile cannot Bite another target until the grapple ends.

name: Elk
appearance: A tall, heavy-bodied deer with a shaggy brown neck, pale rump, and long legs. A bull carries branching antlers.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0, November 2018, p. 125.
sections.Traits: Charge. If the elk moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hits it with Ram on the same turn, it deals 7 (2d6) extra damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone.
sections.Actions:
Ram. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one prone creature. On a hit, deal 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

name: Lion
otherStatistics: Perception +3. Stealth +6. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages.
appearance: A large tawny cat with broad paws and a long tufted tail. The portrait depicts a male with a shaggy brown mane.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0, November 2018, p. 142.
sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. The lion has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on smell.
Pack Tactics. The lion has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if a non-incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of that creature.
Pounce. If the lion moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hits it with Claw on the same turn, the target makes a DC 13 Strength save or falls prone. If it is prone, the lion can Bite it once as a bonus action.
Running Leap. With a 10-ft. running start, the lion can make a long jump of up to 25 ft.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

name: Mammoth
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Passive Perception 10. No listed languages.
appearance: A massive woolly elephant with a domed head, shaggy russet fur, a trunk, and two sweeping ivory tusks.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0, November 2018, p. 143.
sections.Traits: Trampling Charge. If the mammoth moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hits it with Gore on the same turn, the creature makes a DC 18 Strength save or falls prone. If it is prone, the mammoth can Stomp it once as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one prone creature. On a hit, deal 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

name: Panther
otherStatistics: Perception +4. Stealth +6. Passive Perception 14. No listed languages.
appearance: A black-coated climbing cat with a long tail, rounded ears, amber eyes, and faint rosettes on its flanks.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0, November 2018, p. 148.
sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. The panther has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on smell.
Pounce. If the panther moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hits it with Claw on the same turn, the target makes a DC 12 Strength save or falls prone. If it is prone, the panther can Bite it once as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

otherStatistics: Perception +3. Stealth +6. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages.
appearance: A muscular tawny cat with long upper fangs, wide paws, a short tail and a few dark spots across its back.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0, November 2018, p. 151.
sections.Traits:

Pounce. If the tiger moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hits it with Claw on the same turn, the target makes a DC 14 Strength save or falls prone. If it is prone, the tiger can Bite it once as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:

name: Weasel
otherStatistics: Perception +3. Stealth +5. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages.
appearance: A slim brown weasel with a white throat and belly, short legs, and a narrow whiskered face.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0, November 2018, p. 158.
sections.Traits: Keen Hearing and Smell. The weasel has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on hearing or smell.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 1 piercing damage.

name: Wolf

appearance: A gray-brown wolf with a deep chest, long legs, pointed ears, and a bushy tail.
